description: PyPSA-PL: Scenario for the Polish energy transition out to 2040 accounting for grid expansion cost is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Patryk Kubiczek, Kajetan Nowak (Instrat Foundation). This record contains all the scripts and data from the PyPSA-PL modelling exercise that supported the report: Kubiczek P., Nowak K., Smoleń M. (2025). Sieci na miarę. Koszty sieciowe a opłacalność OZE w Polsce do 2040 r. Instrat Policy Paper 03/2025. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
